title: Historical Crown and health logo follow-up

scope.note: Counts apply to the original 133 historical vector gaps, not all gallery bodies. Each SVG preserves original published path geometry. Additional raster references do not reduce the vector-gap count.

bc-buildings-corporation.notes: BCBC mark from its 2003 service plan, with original vector emblem, name and tagline recovered from the 2005 financial statements.

bc-heritage-trust.notes: Trust mark from its 1989 conservation publication, with original vector artwork from the 2001/02 annual report.

bc-assets-and-land-corporation.notes: Original 1999 letterhead and native vector emblem, corporate name and agency tagline from the 1998/99 annual report.

land-and-water-bc.notes: Corporate logo from original financial statements and native vector emblem and name from the 2001/02 service plan report.

capital-health-region.notes: Capital Health Region of Victoria. Two original vector variants and dated raster specimens preserve their source colours and lettering. Dates identify appearances, not adoption.

north-shore-health-region.notes: A reversed original raster survives in a later Trans Canada Trail donor-panel file. Its later file dates document a reproduction, not the logo’s adoption. Earlier recruitment-ad evidence is recorded separately in the research.

northern-interior-regional-health-board.notes: Original blue vector emblem and full name recovered from the July 2001 annual report, alongside the earlier letterhead scan. Dates identify source appearances, not first use.

south-fraser-health-region.notes: Original stacked black vector mark and tagline from the April–May 2001 newsletter, with earlier scans and an original horizontal colour raster from July 2001. Dates identify source appearances, not first use.

simon-fraser-health-region.notes: The earlier recruiting-advertisement scan is joined by an original colour website JPEG and the much larger original monochrome bitmap from the January 2001 Continuum newsletter. All are raster specimens; no vector has been verified. Source and capture dates identify appearances, not adoption.

vancouver-richmond-health-board.notes: Dated print specimens are joined by the original 1200 × 320 colour logo and tagline recovered from the November 2000 diesel review. All collected versions are raster; source dates identify appearances, not adoption.

coast-garibaldi-community-health-service.notes: Original teal Coast Garibaldi Health emblem and name recovered from the society’s archived 2001 website. The original organization page identifies the Community Health Services Society.

campbell-river-nootka-community-health-c.notes: Original full-colour emblem recovered from the council’s archived 2000 website, alongside the later grayscale festival-program specimen. Both are raster source images.

sunshine-coast-community-health-council.notes: The council’s original 2001 website banner preserves its sun, three-person emblem and full name. The photographic background and navigation strip are retained as source context.

greater-trail-community-health-council.notes: Complete people-and-oval emblem and council name recovered from its archived 2001 website. Original grey background and small lettering are preserved.

south-cariboo-community-health-council.notes: The 1999 health plan supplies the complete green trees and council name; the original 2000 website supplies the black standalone tree emblem. Both are raster specimens for the Community Health Council.

bc-resources-investment-corporation.notes: Original 1979 share-certificate artwork is joined by the green BCRIC wordmark from the August 1979 shareholder brochure. Both are raster specimens.

bc-petroleum-corporation.notes: The 1982/83 white-on-black mark is joined by a black symbol from the 1991/92 annual report. Original scan texture and the small adjacent phone-number fragment are retained.
